T019 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (V n)),
  (∀ (X : Type u_1) [inst : MetricSpace X] (A : Set X) (s : ℝ),
      0 < s →
        Hmeasure s A = Hnative s A ∧
          (dimH A < ENNReal.ofReal s → Hmeasure s A = 0) ∧
            (ENNReal.ofReal s < dimH A → Hmeasure s A = ∞) ∧
              (Hmeasure s A = 0 → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s) ∧ (Hmeasure s A = ∞ → ENNReal.ofReal s ≤ dimH A)) →
    (dimH unitI = 1 ∧ ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → s < 1 → Hmeasure s unitI = ∞) →
      (∀ (b δ : ℝ), 0 < b → 0 < δ → Hscale b δ unitI ≤ Hscale b δ (cyl n E)) →
        dimH E = 0 → 1 ≤ dimH (cyl n E) ∧ 1 = dimH E + 1
'Translation.T019' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
